fields.description: Solaya is a gated Jumeirah beachfront collection of 234 homes across nine buildings, developed by Meraas with Brookfield Properties. Foster + Partners designed the architecture and 1508 London the interiors. Classic residences are joined by garden homes, duplexes and penthouses.

overview: Classic residences range from two to five bedrooms. Selected garden homes have their own pool; four-bedroom duplexes and penthouses form separate collections. Cleaning, personal training and other à la carte services should be budgeted separately from general building services.
research.locationNote: On the Jumeirah beachfront beside the J 1 Beach setting. Confirm the selected building, outlook and beach-access terms; nearby hotel and restaurant facilities are not automatically included with ownership.
research.priceNote: The linked developer sheet lists AVERAGE prices: AED 16.56 m two bedrooms; 26.83 m three; 35.78 m four; 54.69 m five; 113.95 m penthouse. These are not minimum prices or confirmed unit offers.
research.paymentNote: The currently linked sheet requires 20% booking, 10% May 2027, 10% November 2027, 10% May 2028, 10% November 2028 and 40% April 2030 handover. It is not a personalised contract. Confirm whether this release’s calendar applies to the chosen building.
research.handoverNote: The current linked payment sheet estimates April 2030. An older broker reference gives June 2029. Keep each release’s schedule separate and obtain the selected unit’s signed date.
